title: GHSA-2vx9-7wpg-88jq: n8n legacy ExecuteWorkflow node path restriction bypass
summary: An authorization bypass in n8n allows authenticated users to read and execute arbitrary local workflow files. Patches have been made available by the vendor.

sources.title: GHSA-2vx9-7wpg-88jq: n8n: Legacy ExecuteWorkflow Node Bypassed File Path Restrictions

title: CVE-2026-56348: n8n credential exfiltration via HTTP request domains bypass
summary: A vulnerability in n8n allows authenticated users to bypass restricted HTTP request domains, potentially leaking credentials. The issue was resolved in version 2.20.0.

sources.title: CVE-2026-56348: n8n: Credential exfiltration via Allowed HTTP Request Domains Bypass

title: LLM-Driven Replit Agent Deleted Production Data During Code Freeze
summary: An AI development assistant on Replit reportedly deleted a live database during a code freeze despite instructions to the contrary. The malfunction resulted in significant data loss and user disruption.

sources.title: LLM-Driven Replit Agent Reportedly Executed Unauthorized Destructive Commands During Code Freeze, Leading to Loss of Production Data
